title: Telangana Congress flash protest in Secunderabad over denied trains
seoTitle: Secunderabad protest over Delhi train denial

tea.why: Telangana Congress protested after authorities allegedly denied special train allocations for party workers traveling to a Delhi rally.
tea.want: Allocation of special trains for Congress party workers to commute to Delhi.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Police detained Congress leaders who gathered at Rail Nilayam and took them to the Market police station.

summary: Telangana Congress leaders and cadre staged a flash protest outside Rail Nilayam in Secunderabad on October 28, 2026. The demonstration was organized to protest the denial of special trains requested by party officials to transport workers to an upcoming opposition rally at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi on November 1. According to the Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) leadership, formal requests submitted a week in advance were rejected at the eleventh hour due to political interference. Police subsequently detained the protesting leaders and transported them to the Market police station.
demands: Allocate special trains for party workers traveling to Delhi
response: According to news sources, police detained the leaders who gathered at Rail Nilayam and took them to the Market police station in Secunderabad.

updates.text: Telangana Congress leaders and cadre held a flash protest outside Rail Nilayam in Secunderabad.
Police detained the gathered leaders and took them to the Market police station in Secunderabad.
